body.label: Trigger
body.html: A creature within 3 units fails an Action or has an Action fail against you.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Make the triggering creature Exposed. If it was already Exposed, it instead burns 1 die.

surges.html: If the triggering enemy is Exposed or has a normal Condition, it cannot make another Reaction until the start of its next turn.
After declaration, change one eligible target or destination of this Reaction by up to 1 unit.
